'''Diva Arroquitas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] who was the master of ceremonies in the [[Priole Danna Festival]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lamuir IV]]<ref name="HoloNet News" /> in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|life/13228_1.html|Priole Danna Festival Still a Go}} is dated to 13:2:28 in the [[Great ReSynchronization calendar]], which corresponds to [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> just one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] began.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|43|Arroquitas, Diva}}</ref> The following year, Arroquitas refused to travel during the ongoing [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] for the 2,345th festival, though its director [[Eizzam Stachrini]] insisted the festival would continue as scheduled.<ref name="HoloNet News" /> However, the festival ultimately was canceled due to security concerns.<ref name="CSWE" />

Arroquitas was a member of the [[Diva]]s,<ref name="DB" /> a religious order of Theelin [[Musician/Legends|singers]] known for their [[Opera/Legends|operatic]] forms.<ref name="CSWE Divas">{{CSWECite|I|191|Divas}}</ref>
